metadata.name: veilai
metadata.description: VeilAI — private, verifiable execution infrastructure for AI agents

docs: VeilAI — private, verifiable execution infrastructure for AI agents.
Phase 1 (this module): core job lifecycle on the base layer.
PER delegation/permissions (Phase 2), attestation verification (Phase 3),
and Magic Action settlement (Phase 4) are added incrementally — see plan.md.

instructions.name: close_permission
docs: Close the job's EphemeralPermission on the ER (before undelegation).

instructions.name: create_job
docs: Create a confidential job. Only commitments are stored on-chain; the
plaintext prompt never touches the account.

instructions.name: delegate_job
docs: Delegate the Job data PDA into the (private) Ephemeral Rollup (base layer).

instructions.name: deposit_escrow
docs: Escrow the job budget in a program-controlled USDC vault before
execution — the funds verification will later release or refund.

instructions.name: execute_marker
docs: Provider marks the delegated job as executing (ER).

instructions.name: init_permission
docs: Create the job's EphemeralPermission on the ER (members = creator+provider).

instructions.name: refund_escrow_direct
docs: Refund escrow to the creator for a Rejected job (direct, Signer-authorized).

instructions.name: register_agent
docs: Register an AI agent with its allowlisted enclave measurement, quoting
key, model id, config commitment, and price. `agent_id` is unique per
authority, so one operator can list many agents.

instructions.name: set_permission
docs: Replace the job's EphemeralPermission member list on the ER.

instructions.name: settle_payment_direct
docs: Release escrow to the provider for a Verified job (direct, Signer-authorized).

instructions.name: verify_attestation
docs: Verify the enclave attestation (Ed25519 precompile + measurement
allowlist) and record Verified/Rejected. See `verify_attestation.rs`.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.msg: Caller is not authorized for this action

errors.name: BadStatus
errors.msg: Job is not in the required status for this action

errors.name: MeasurementMismatch
errors.msg: Enclave measurement does not match the agent allowlist

errors.name: QuotingKeyMismatch
errors.msg: Quoting key is not allowlisted for this agent

errors.name: ReportDataMismatch
errors.msg: Report data binding does not match the job commitments

errors.name: InvalidBudget
errors.msg: Budget must be greater than zero

types.name: Agent
docs: A registered AI agent. An authority may register many agents, distinguished
by `agent_id` — a marketplace operator holds one wallet and many listings.

fields.name: agent_id
docs: Unique per authority; part of the PDA seed.

fields.name: model_id
docs: Model identifier used when recomputing the attestation report data.

fields.name: config_commitment
docs: sha256 over the agent's definition (system prompt ‖ model ‖ params).
Bound into every job's `input_commitment`, so an attestation proves which
agent definition ran — not merely that *some* enclave ran. Pinning it
here makes a silently edited agent detectable: the commitment a client
used is checkable against the one the agent advertises.

fields.name: expected_measurement
docs: Allowlisted enclave measurement (MRTD).

fields.name: quoting_key
docs: ed25519 public key of the enclave quoting key (stub TEE key in the MVP).

fields.name: price
docs: Price per job, USDC base units.

fields.name: reputation
docs: Reputation, basis points (0..=10_000).

types.name: Job
docs: A confidential job. Sensitive plaintext never lives here — only commitments.

fields.name: agent
docs: The Agent PDA selected for this job.

fields.name: provider
docs: Provider wallet (agent.authority), copied so ER-side auth needs no agent read.

fields.name: budget
docs: USDC base units held in escrow for this job.

fields.name: prompt_ciphertext_commitment
docs: sha256 of the ciphertext handed to the enclave.

fields.name: input_commitment
docs: Commitment to the plaintext input (bound into report_data).

fields.name: output_commitment
docs: Commitment to the output, recorded on verification.

fields.name: expected_measurement
docs: Copied from the agent at creation so the allowlist is fixed for the job.

fields.name: model_id
docs: Copied from the agent; needed to recompute report_data on-chain.

fields.name: nonce
docs: Random per-job nonce binding the attestation.

fields.name: settlement_id
docs: Idempotency key guarding settlement.

fields.name: settled
docs: True once escrow has been released or refunded (guards double-settle).

constants.name: AGENT_SEED
docs: PDA seed prefixes — mirrored in `shared/src/config.ts`.
